theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_tangentSpace_subset_range_of_secant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (q : Euclid P) (A : Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, dist y q < δ → ∃ a : Euclid d, ‖y - q - A a‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - q‖) → tangentSpace N q ⊆ Set.range A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
